groups.D: SHA-256 digest of a pinned file, stored as JSON unicode escapes.
groups.H: SHA-256 from host_key(), a local coordination hash, stored as JSON unicode escapes.
groups.U: UUID tokenizer id, stored as JSON unicode escapes.
groups.R: Reviewer principal id: api_key: plus the API-key row primary key, not the credential.
groups.F: 32-hex fencing identifier in a finished qualification report. ANVIL-017 ruled it is not a live credential.
